root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure queried Unified Brain Delivery with event=pull_request even though unified-brain-delivery.yml is workflow_dispatch-only, making terminal closure wait for evidence that could never exist.
fix: Accept successful exact-head Unified Brain Delivery evidence independent of event type when present; otherwise require successful exact-merge Brain foundation verify push evidence.
prevention: Never bind terminal proof to an event type absent from the referenced workflow.
Prefer exact-head Brain delivery evidence when it exists.
Fallback only to exact-merge Brain foundation verification, never to an unrelated or stale SHA.
Failed or absent Brain evidence remains fail-closed.
